steps.title: Welcome to Launchpad
steps.body: A short tour of the main screens. It takes under a minute, and you can close it at any point and pick it up again from the help menu.
Flows automate the repetitive parts of this app. Have a look, though you do not have to build one now.

observability._note: LaunchPad consumes the OpenRegister AppHost observability engine (ADR-040). These descriptors reproduce the output of the now-deleted hand-written HealthController + MetricsController. The /api/health and /api/metrics routes are aliased to the AppHost generic controllers in lib/AppInfo/Application.php, so the engine reads this block at request time. The Prometheus prefix is the runtime app id `launchpad`. Parity: implicit launchpad_info/launchpad_up plus launchpad_dashboards_total/widgets_total/tiles_total match the pre-adoption contract; documented intentional improvements are the now-public health endpoint and the added health `app`/`version` fields (ADR-006).

pages.title: launchpad.pages.dashboard
pages._note: Bundled STUB for the ADR-036 Decision-8 runtime-manifest pattern: the real per-user dashboard pages are assembled server-side by GET /apps/launchpad/api/manifest from the user's visible dashboards and replace this manifest at boot. widgets[] is intentionally empty here — LaunchPad has no static home page. The 'dashboards' menu entry targets this page by ID rather than by path, which is the pairing the SERVER emits: ManifestController::buildManifest() sets each menu entry's route to its page's id ('dashboard-'.$slug) while the page carries the path ('/'.$slug). The stub previously said '/dashboards' — a path matching neither this page ('/dashboards/:id') nor anything the runtime builder produces — so the single menu entry LaunchPad ships resolved to nothing.

pages.title: launchpad.pages.adminTemplates
pages._note: Admin CRUD over the launchpad app-config/templates table, rendered by LaunchPad's own admin chrome (src/components/admin/tabs/TemplatesPage.vue). No OpenRegister register/schema backs this data, so the declarative index page type (which requires register + schema) cannot apply.

pages.title: launchpad.pages.adminSettings
pages._note: Bespoke admin settings surface (tile/template management forms) rendered by LaunchPad's own router; manages app-config state that no declarative widget vocabulary covers.

pages.title: Flows
pages._note: ADR-110 Decision 4: a flow is app-specific, so the authoring surface lives here rather than behind a deep link to another app's list. An ordinary index over the named `flows` source (config.entitySource) rather than the deprecated `flows` page type, reading OpenRegister's one native flow store (ADR-065), scoped to this app by config.app.

pages.title: Flow
pages._note: The shared CnFlowDetail canvas over the same single engine. Controls render in the NC app sidebar so the canvas keeps full width.
